titles_romaji.title: Agi Salgeul Naajwo, Na Michineun Kkol Bogi Sileumyeon!

description:
Goh Yu-Min, the eldest son of an endangered black-footed wildcat clan, has never even met a female of his own kind and is doomed to a lifelong single status. Now freshly in heat and losing his mind to breeding instinct, he catches wind of a secret rumor: a male wildcat can perfectly pair with a human man and impregnate him without fail. Determined to continue his family line, Yu-Min sneaks into Hanguk University in search of the most beautiful and brilliant man he can find, and that is where he meets Beom Tae-Jun, a stunning senior with an irresistible body. Yu-Min sets aside his pride and desperately attempts to court him, only to end up pinned beneath Tae-Jun on his own bed. To his shock, Yu-Min realizes he is the one being “bred,” not the other way around. Even as he tries to escape, he finds himself addicted to Tae-Jun’s touch.

Can Yu-Min break free, or will he lose himself completely before he can secure the baby wildcat needed to carry on his family’s bloodline?

(Source: Lezhin US)
